relationToExistingStudies.usCapitalAllocationAlphaV1: independent; v1 (design digest 73c347a34bc53f038c9e33ebbc2cb322960f33fc4170919b85d2561a4f073342) is neither modified nor replaced
relationToExistingStudies.usMultifactorStudyProposalV1: supersedes the Phase 2 proposal's CHOICE OF FIRST TEST only (value + cash-confirmed quality composite); that proposal file is not edited. Reasons: the composite needs a reconstructed price basis and unverified numerator share counts, its components have prior outcome-exposed US readings in a different construction, and a five-part composite cannot say which part carries information
relationToExistingStudies.regionalAlphaModelV1: its 31-feature matrix held no cash-flow feature; this test is not a rerun of a closed budget

primaryHypothesis.economic: Within the S&P 500 excluding Financials and Real Estate, companies whose trailing operating cash flow is high relative to their assets earn higher subsequent returns than companies with the same sector, size, 12-1 momentum, 252-day volatility and ACCRUAL-based operating profitability.
primaryHypothesis.mechanism: cash profits are harder to manage than accrual profits and investors under-weight the cash component of earnings (accrual and cash-profitability literature); it is a hypothesis, not a result
primaryHypothesis.incrementalNotCorrelational: the claim is about the part of the cash-profitability ranking that the control set does NOT already order; the raw IC is reported but cannot carry the claim. Measured outcome-blind: cashOperatingProfitability orders names like operatingProfitabilityToAssets at mean within-date Spearman 0.771 (above the repository's 0.70 redundancy flag) and like ROE at 0.59, so after the accrual-profitability control the residual is essentially the CASH-VERSUS-ACCRUAL component (accrualsToAssets is near-orthogonal to the control, 0.136). The test is therefore an accrual-quality test inside profitability, stated before any outcome
primaryHypothesis.publicationDecayRisk: the effect is published and well known; a smaller or zero effect in 2026+ large caps is a live possibility and is an informative outcome, not a failure of the design

features.primary: cashOperatingProfitability = operating cash flow TTM / total assets of the latest visible filing
features.descriptiveCompanion: accrualsToAssets = (net income TTM - operating cash flow TTM) / total assets; expected sign negative; never a second primary
features.timing: a filing is usable only on days strictly after max(availableFrom, acceptedDate); latest visible period end; stale over 180 days
features.ttm: finnhub_derive rollforward FY(Y-1) - cum(Y-1,Q) + cum(Y,Q); a missing prior filing is OCF_TTM_INCOMPLETE_CHAIN, never an annualisation
features.missingSemantics: every absence carries one reason code; missing is never zero; no imputation in the primary statistic (complete-case within date, counts and missingness bias published)

eligibleCrossSection.membership: S&P 500, latest dated snapshot strictly earlier than the signal date
eligibleCrossSection.priceAndIdentity: Phase 2 funnel: positive close at most 10 calendar days old, at least 272 prior sessions, identity unambiguous
eligibleCrossSection.whyExcluded: operating cash flow and total assets do not measure operating profitability for banks, insurers and REITs
eligibleCrossSection.complete: primary feature AND every control present
eligibleCrossSection.minimumBasis: fixed from the outcome-blind readiness count (docs/us-readiness/us-alpha-phase3-readiness-v1.json), never from a return

controls.size: log 63-session median as-traded traded value (as-traded close x volume from the sealed price panel; withheld when a split falls in the window). Chosen over the market-cap proxy BEFORE any outcome because it is ~99% available and needs no unverified share count; the two agree only at mean within-date Spearman 0.72, so the market-cap proxy (carried-forward weighted-average shares x as-traded close) is a registered SENSITIVITY, never the primary control
controls.accrualProfitability: operatingProfitabilityToAssets = operating income TTM / total assets (same denominator)
controls.why: market is removed by the benchmark-relative, dollar-neutral construction; sector, size, momentum and volatility are the exposures already known to order US returns or already tested here; accrual profitability isolates the CASH component

target.label: total return over the next 63 US sessions minus SPY's total return over the same sessions, entry at the first session after the signal close
target.benchmarkInvariance: the primary weights sum to zero within every sector, so SPY (and QQQ) cancel exactly: the statistic is the same against either benchmark and a benchmark change can never read as selection
target.terminalOutcomes: a name that stops trading inside the window is UNRESOLVED unless a cited terminal consideration exists; never zero, never last price; any UNRESOLVED name in a scored date makes that date's statistic missing and is counted

horizons.whyPrimary: one quarterly filing cycle: the information set is refreshed every ~63 sessions, so H63 uses each vintage for its natural life; it matures in ~3 months and each window spans fewer terminal events than H126/H252. Power does NOT decide it: if the IC grows like sqrt(horizon) the power table is roughly horizon-neutral (IC/MDE at 5 years: H21 31.6c, H63 32.0c, H126 33.1c, H252 38.4c for IC_21 = c); decay within a quarter favours short horizons and slow build-up favours long ones, and which applies is unknown

primaryClaim.statistic: pure-factor spread: on each weekly signal date, OLS-residualise the within-date percentile rank of cashOperatingProfitability on sector dummies and the percentile ranks of the four continuous controls; weights proportional to the residual, scaled to gross exposure 2 ($1 long / $1 short); S_t = sum_i w_i * excess_i(H63); claim = mean over signal dates
properties: linear in returns with signal-date weights (calendar-time attribution applies)
exactly orthogonal to every sector and control rank on each date
rank-based, so a single outlier cannot dominate
primaryClaim.inference: calendar-time SN interval after a US-geometry calibration (prerequisite P3); until it passes, the registration cannot be frozen

descriptive: within-sector quintile spread Q5-Q1, equal weight
by year, first/second half, and SPY trailing-126-session up/down regime
long-only top-quintile (sector-weighted) minus SPY after 16.3 bp round-trip cost per unit turnover
secondaryAndDescriptive.correlationVersusIncrement: raw IC minus pure-factor spread is reported as the part explained by the controls; a positive raw IC with a zero pure-factor spread is classified REDUNDANT, not supported

transactionCosts.source: pipeline/benchmark_alpha.py REALISTIC_COSTS['US'] (as in the Phase 2 proposal)
transactionCosts.use: descriptive economic significance only; the signal test is gross because it measures information, and the cost test asks whether the turnover the signal implies would consume it

evidenceClasses.what: this protocol, the readiness audit and the power table
exactly this protocol run once on replay-v16 2013-2026 (survivor-conditioned: 212 departed identities have no prices)
evidenceClasses.status: PROPOSED; needs its own authorization; NOT run here
evidenceClasses.allowedUse: futility screen only: if the development one-sided 95% upper bound is <= 0 the hypothesis is abandoned before prospective collection starts; a favourable development reading is never reported as confirmation and changes no threshold, feature or horizon
evidenceClasses.survivorshipDirection: departed names are disproportionately low-profitability failures; their absence most plausibly understates a positive effect, which is a hypothesis, not a measurement

evidenceClasses.what: weekly signals dated after the authorizing merge of a registration

decisionRules.gate: single efficacy look after 260 weekly signal dates have matured at H63 (about 5 years and 3 months after the first signal)
decisionRules.supported: one-sided 95% lower bound of the primary mean > 0
decisionRules.redundant: raw IC lower bound > 0 but the primary is not supported
decisionRules.unstable: supported overall but opposite signs in the two halves of the prospective period
decisionRules.inconclusive: anything else, including too many UNRESOLVED dates (> 10%)
decisionRules.futility: one pre-declared look at 130 matured signal dates: stop if conditional power under the planning effect is below 10%; no efficacy interim
decisionRules.noRetroactiveChange: features, controls, horizon, statistic, gate and floors cannot change after the first signal; a change is a new study id

falsification: prospective primary upper bound <= 0 at the gate
development (exploratory) upper bound <= 0 before prospective collection (futility screen)
the sector-neutral-only spread is positive while the full pure-factor spread is not (the information is sector, size, momentum, volatility or accrual profitability, not cash)

powerPlanning.source: docs/us-readiness/us-alpha-phase3-readiness-v1.json powerPlanning (variance side of the committed four-factor report only)
powerPlanning.reading: an S&P 500-only prospective test detects a mean IC of about 0.05 at H63 after ~6 years and ~0.03 at H21 after ~5.5 years; residualising on the controls may reduce the dispersion and is not assumed. A realistic large-cap effect may therefore be INCONCLUSIVE at the gate, and the protocol says so in advance

prerequisitesBeforeRegistration.what: append-only daily US close + volume + dividends/splits for every S&P 500 member, SPY and QQQ on signal-history (the KR analogue ledger/prices/kr exists; no US analogue exists)
prerequisitesBeforeRegistration.why: no fresh US price exists after 2026-09-14; without it no signal can be formed and no departed name's last price can be preserved

prerequisitesBeforeRegistration.what: dated weekly S&P 500 membership snapshot appended to signal-history (latest committed snapshot 2026-09-05)
Monte Carlo calibration of the calendar-time SN interval for ~350 names, weekly signals, H63 (reuse the alpha-inference-calibration engine with a US geometry)
one authorized exploratory run of this exact protocol on replay-v16
hash-freeze feature code, controls, statistic and gate before the first prospective signal

forbiddenInThisProposal: choosing a feature, control, horizon, weight or threshold from a return
a 0-5 name book before the signal is measured on the broad cross-section
